scope: Faster inspection walking, enterable doors, manual/automatic controls and drawing-based person view

manualControls: F toggles nearby faced eligible doorway
behavior.automaticControls: Checkbox enables approach opening and delayed departure closing for enterable:true leaves only
behavior.closedReviewedThreshold: Crossing waits until all leaves have opened
behavior.connectedRoute: campus Team-2 rear entry <-> packaging first-floor entry; person view retained
behavior.portalContinuity: One F operation; paired threshold stays open across transition; spawn 0.9m inside / 1.7m outside
behavior.pairedLeaves: one interaction synchronizes leaves, elevator panels and curtain strips
behavior.drawingDecision: Retain reviewed metric dimensions; view scale adjusts camera projection

featureCoverage: checkbox/button/settings in local and shared apps

browser.manualF: Actual Team-2 rear doorway opened after F; state carried to the first-floor doorway
browser.automatic: Checkbox hides manual button, updates hint and focuses canvas
browser.persistence: automatic=true and scale=.8 survived reload; review preferences reset to false/1
browser.shared: Standalone iframe ready=true; person controls and checkbox respond; no console errors

limits: Existing wall pass-through navigation is retained; closed reviewed doorway thresholds require opening.
Measured drawing values, video proportions and unmeasured geometry are distinguished in scale-audit.json.
Liquid orbit inspection is not treated as a walking person and cannot trigger proximity doors.
